new.x: NSTR, India's largest tiger reserve, lies in the Nallamala hills across five districts of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

new.s: How many Ramsar sites did India have in 2026?
new.x: India has 100 Ramsar sites (2026); Kolleru in AP has been one since 2002.

new.x: The Ganges River Dolphin was declared India's National Aquatic Animal on 5 October 2009; 5 October is now National Dolphin Day.

new.x: The IBCA is open to 96 range countries of the seven big cats and also to non-range countries; it has 27 members.

new.s: What is the full form of M-STrIPES used in tiger reserves?
o: Monitoring Scheme for Tigers - Indian Population Estimation Study
Mapping System for Tiger Ranges - Intensive Patrol and Evaluation Scheme
Monitoring System for Tigers - Intensive Protection and Ecological Status
Management System for Tiger Reserves - Integrated Patrol and Estimation Survey

new.s: Which State had the highest number of tigers in the 2022 All India Tiger Estimation?
new.x: Madhya Pradesh had 785 tigers in 2022, ahead of Karnataka (563), Uttarakhand (560) and Maharashtra (444).

new.s: What was the goal of TX2, adopted at the 2010 Global Tiger Summit in St Petersburg?
o: To double the number of wild tigers by 2022
To create 20 new tiger reserves by 2020
To ban the trade in tiger parts by 2015
To translocate tigers to all range countries
new.x: TX2 aimed to double wild tiger numbers by 2022, a goal India met early.

new.s: The snow leopard was declared the national symbol of which country in December 2023?

new.s: Where was the crocodile sub-project for the saltwater crocodile (Baula) set up?
new.x: The Baula (saltwater crocodile) sub-project was at Dangamal in Bhitarkanika, Odisha; the mugger sub-project was at Ramatirtha.

new.s: What are tuskless male Asian elephants called?
new.x: Only male Asian elephants have tusks; tuskless males are called makhnas.

new.s: Which veterinary drug is the safe alternative to diclofenac for vultures?
new.x: Meloxicam is safe for vultures; diclofenac (2006) and aceclofenac and ketoprofen (2023) were banned for animal use.

new.s: Under the Indian Forest Act, 1927, which category of forest gets the highest degree of protection?
new.x: Reserved forests are the strictest category: felling, grazing and hunting are barred unless permitted; the order is Reserved > Protected > Village.

new.s: Under the Indian Forest Act, 1927, in which category of forest are activities allowed unless they are specifically prohibited?
new.x: In protected forests (Chapter IV) activities are allowed unless prohibited, so they get less protection than reserved forests.
